# Hockey Edge: Puck StatScout

> Puck StatScout is an NHL stats app for iPhone with expected goals and advanced percentile rankings for skaters and goalies: ixG, GSAx and Corsi. No account.

## App

- [NHL Stats App for iPhone | Hockey Edge: Puck StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/hockey/index.html.md): Puck StatScout is an NHL stats app for iPhone with expected goals and advanced percentile rankings for skaters and goalies: ixG, GSAx and Corsi. No account.

## Guides

- [What Is xG in Hockey? Expected Goals and GSAx Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/hockey/what-is-xg-in-hockey.html.md): Expected goals (xG) give every NHL shot a probability of scoring. See how xG works, how goalies are judged with GSAx, and what good numbers look like.
